description: benchmarks/go.mod replaces these three with sibling checkouts (../../qcow2, ../../raw, ../../dmg), so the require line there is a floor and not what gets built.

Renovate cannot update it even if it wanted to: it clones this repository alone, so ../../qcow2 does not exist in its container and `go mod tidy` fails with 'reading ../../qcow2/go.mod: no such file or directory'.
And there is nothing to write: a module replaced by a local path needs no checksum, and benchmarks/go.sum holds zero entries for any of the three.

The result was a renovate/artifacts failure on every dependency pull request touching this module, which ghmerge refuses and which no change could ever clear. A check that cannot pass teaches people to ignore the lane.
